author: Cinna Davis
statement: The first tapered polynomial H_1 is exactly realizable on one prescribed packet over Z_(2); the last level H_a is realizable at every prescribed finite precision by coprime Hensel lifting, using affine row and zero-plus-one-hot column tensors.
remaining_obligations: One-packet factorization for intermediate taper levels
Actual balanced packing and a generic-scale Boolean precision witness
